data.credibility: Management demonstrates moderate reliability by keeping core margin and marketing spend promises and actively reiterating them. However, they frequently drop or fail to report on distribution and capex targets, indicating a pattern of quiet omission on operational expansion metrics.

lines.line: Operating margin maintained at 20.3 percent, staying within the 19 to 21 percent target range.
Full year marketing spend delivered at 4 percent, meeting the 4 to 5 percent target.
General trade outlet additions target of 8,000 to 9,000 was dropped without reporting.
Capex spend target of INR140 crores for FY26 was dropped without reporting.
Aims for double-digit volume growth for the financial year, currently pending evaluation.
Distributor DMS network integration targeted by end of year or Q1 next year is pending.
